objects.name: memory_fact
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX memory_fact ON memory(scope,workspace,fact_key)

objects.name: session_messages_session
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX session_messages_session ON session_messages(session_id)

objects.name: sessions_updated_at
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX sessions_updated_at ON sessions(updated_at DESC)

objects.name: indexed_sessions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE indexed_sessions (
            session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            project TEXT, mode TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: memory
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE memory (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, content TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', workspace TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', fact_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, source TEXT)

objects.name: memory_proposals
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE memory_proposals (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: memory_search
objects.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE memory_search USING fts5(id UNINDEXED, content)

objects.name: memory_search_config
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'memory_search_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: memory_search_content
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'memory_search_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1)

objects.name: memory_search_data
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'memory_search_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

objects.name: memory_search_docsize
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'memory_search_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

objects.name: memory_search_idx
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'memory_search_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: message_search
objects.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE message_search USING fts5(content, content='session_messages', content_rowid='id')

objects.name: message_search_config
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'message_search_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: message_search_data
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'message_search_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

objects.name: message_search_docsize
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'message_search_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

objects.name: message_search_idx
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'message_search_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: paired_devices
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE paired_devices (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: session_messages
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE session_messages (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, session_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            message_id TEXT NOT NULL, message_index INTEGER NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL,
            content TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: sessions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: settings
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE settings (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: message_delete
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER message_delete AFTER DELETE ON session_messages BEGIN
            INSERT INTO message_search(message_search,rowid,content) VALUES ('delete',old.id,old.content); END

objects.name: message_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER message_insert AFTER INSERT ON session_messages BEGIN
            INSERT INTO message_search(rowid,content) VALUES (new.id,new.content); END
